convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 moving average indicators (iMA) with standard parameters. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot position sizing. No external .mqh libraries or custom indicators. Straightforward logic suitable for automated conversion.

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal closes the current position before opening a new one in the reverse direction

custom_logic_notes: EA is split into two separate files - one for buy entries (M.A break mt5 buy.mq5) and one for sell entries (M.A break mt5 sell.mq5). Each file handles only one direction of the moving average crossover strategy. The buy EA enters long on fast MA crossing above slow MA; the sell EA enters short on fast MA crossing below slow MA. Crossover detection uses previous bar values (shift 1 and 2) to confirm the cross occurred on the last completed bar. SL/TP pip values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: Simple dual EMA crossover strategy. Two separate EAs can be merged into a single Python strategy with both long and short entry logic. Use ta-lib or pandas for EMA calculation. Key: crossover detection must compare bar[-1] vs bar[-2] values (previous completed bar crossover, not current bar). SL/TP need digit adjustment logic: if price has 5 decimal places, multiply pip values by 10. Position gate ensures only one position at a time. New bar guard prevents multiple entries within same bar.
